cards.title: Today’s vocabulary
sections: a story shown as moving pictures. Mia and Puck watch a movie at seven.
a place where people watch movies; usually called a movie theater in American English. The cinema is next to the station.
a person who plays a character in a movie, play, or show. My favorite actor is in this movie.
a woman who acts in movies, plays, or shows; actor can also be used. The actress plays a doctor in the film.
a movie; a story shown in moving pictures. This film is about two friends.

articulation.alt: watch: /w/ → /ɑ/ → /tʃ/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /w/: Round the lips; raise the back of the tongue.
